# Style fixtures

Synthetic texts for the style-match tests (design/changes/0004), written for this repository from small
sentence pools (Apache-2.0 like the rest of the tests):

- `author-*.md`: eight posts by one made-up author: short first-person sentences, contractions,
  parentheses, a code block, no headings, bold or "you". The reference texts.
- `real-*.md`: three more posts by the same author, held out from the reference.
- `generic-*.md`: a generic listicle on the same topics (headings, bold lists, "you").
- `ghost-*.md`: an exaggerated imitation (dashes, rhetorical questions, bold, pep-talk endings), the
  kind a ghostwriting model produces from a style description.
